# Lulu

> Lulu is a macOS app from Falcao SL. It manages local inference engines and models, starts a server with an OpenAI-compatible API on that Mac, and shows memory and speed when the engine reports them.

## Pages

- [English](https://lulu.falcaosl.com/): product page and downloads
- [Português](https://lulu.falcaosl.com/index.pt.html): the same page in Brazilian Portuguese
- [Releases](https://github.com/Falcao-SL/Lulu/releases): macOS installers

## Facts

- Publisher: Falcao SL (https://falcaosl.com/#org)
- Platforms: macOS 14 or later. Apple Silicon runs MLX and GGUF. Intel Macs use GGUF with llama.cpp.
- The local server listens on this Mac only. The default endpoint is http://127.0.0.1:8000/v1.
- Inference stays on the Mac. Searching and downloading models, and installing engines, use the network.
- Packages are ad hoc signed and are not notarized by Apple. On first launch, right-click Lulu and choose Open.
- Current downloads are listed in https://lulu.falcaosl.com/release.json and are replaced when a GitHub Release is published.
